{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the -1 values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {sales['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA test orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_orders.shape[0]}")

# Summary
sales_shape = sales.shape
print(f"Total rows in dataset: {sales_shape[0]}")"}
